name: Second brain
blurb: One person's people, projects, notes, tasks, habits and reading, with where each piece came from.
about: A second brain your agents keep rather than just store: they file what arrives against the people, projects and commitments it concerns, and answer what you owe someone, what to do next and who told you a thing. Your people, projects, notes, tasks, habits and reading are one record, each piece linked to the message, email or memo it came from, so an answer can be checked against the words that produced it. You review what an agent writes on a branch before it joins the record.
